## Help agents solve the most complex problems withcontext graphs.

A customer send an email asking to return an order past the 30-day window, bought under an enterprise agreement, after three prior returns this quarter, and their rep promised an exception on a call. Do we accept it?

One single email requires five different kinds of context, each owned by a different team. The returns policy doesn’t know the call, the ERP doesn’t know the agreement, and so on. Our context graph, Trail, holds every rule cited to the document it came from.

[How Trail, our context graph, works →](https://trailhq.com/)

- ### Returns policy


Policy context ➔What is allowed?

30 days, so exceptions need a manager.

- ### ERP order record


System-of-record context ➔What did they buy?

SO-4471 is the enterprise agreement, dated 62 days ago.

- ### Return history


Computed context ➔How often is this?

There were 3 returns this quarter, $84K in total.

- ### Call notes & email


Conversation context ➔What was promised?

Rep agreed an exception on 4 Aug.

- ### Exception SOP


SOP context ➔Who approves, in what order?

Support lead → finance, logged on the order.

### Trail: Context Graphs

Trail converts your enterprise policies, procedures, systems, and institutional knowledge into a governed graph for AI.

01Import your documentationDrop in the SOP, policy docs, and other forms of documentation of your business processes. A PDF / DOCX upload or simply a set of instructions.

claims-adjudication-SOP.pdf

Claims Adjudication — Auto & Property

Confidential

Standard Operating Procedure

Purpose

Adjudicate each first-notice-of-loss claim against the active policy. Return a decision, the payable amount, and a rationale.

1\. Coverage & eligibility

The deductible is applied before any payable amount is calculated.

2\. Documentation requirements

- Water damage — dated photos and a plumber's report.
- Bodily injury — an itemized medical bill.

3\. Escalation matrix

| Claim value | Route to | Sign-off | SLA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Under $2,500 | Auto-adjudicate | None | Instant |
| $2,500 – $10,000 | Desk adjuster | 1 reviewer | 24 h |
| $10,000 – $50,000 | Field adjuster | 1 reviewer | 72 h |
| Over $50,000 | Senior adjuster | 2 reviewers | 5 days |

02Parsed into a context graphNanonets extracts rules and parses them into a context graph. Every business rule is traceable to its source, giving AI agents a consistent, auditable source of truth across teams, systems, geographies.

SOP · page 15

“…the deductible is applied before any payable amount is calculated…”

Extracted rule

Apply the deductible first, then compute the payout.

“hurricane-season FL claims — skip the inspection if photos are timestamped within 48h”

Extracted rule

Skip inspection when photos are within 48 h of the event.

“nothing over $50k should ever go out without two sign-offs”

Extracted rule
